reserveReview.rationale: R02 refresh 2026-08-08: Avalon documentation still describes two mint paths (FBTC-backed CeDeFi CDP loan; USDT/USDC deposited 1:1) and 1:1 USDT conversion via an Ethereum vault, with no published supply-weighted split between FBTC-collateralized debt and 1:1 fiat-token deposits. Risk-management still lists FBTC (60% max LTV / 90% liquidation / 80% recovery, liquidatable) plus USDC and USDT at 100% max LTV and not subject to liquidation, and names Cobo, Fireblocks, and Coinbase Prime for protocol-asset custody without publishing addresses, provider shares, or segregation terms. DefiLlama's avalon-usda CDP adapter methodology counts FBTC collateral plus optional USDT/USDe/sUSDe at documented pool and USDaMinter Safe owners; the live protocol endpoint reports ~$2 TVL (residual USDe only) versus ~$148M DefiLlama circulating USDa. The adapter source explicitly excludes Avalon-minted wrappers (lfbtc, WFBTC) and V3/Movement treasuries as team-only/dead-liquidity positions. On-chain adapter balances therefore do not reconcile circulating liability, and no dual-source percentage split is available, so the single reserve is dispositioned as an untracked exogenous asset rather than a splittable basket.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Officially documented issuance and collateral paths; constituent shares remain undisclosed; independent DefiLlama CDP TVL and circulating-supply read confirm non-reconciliation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The single disclosed reserve category is now classified as an untracked exogenous CeDeFi envelope. Avalon does not publish the current proportions of FBTC-backed debt, USDT deposits, and USDC deposits, and on-chain adapter balances do not measure full backing.
